# Projection of Adobe-GB1-6/cid2code.txt from cmap-resources 20231115:
# the CID and UniGB-UTF32 columns, rows without a UniGB-UTF32 value omitted.
# cid2code.txt (Version 09/21/2023)
#
# The data in this table contains 14 tab-delimited columns of
# information. The contents of this file supplement "The Adobe-GB1-6
# Character Collection" (formerly Adobe Tech Note #5079):
#
# https://github.com/adobe-type-tools/Adobe-GB1/
#
# This table contains lists CIDs 0 through 30571 in the first column,
# and provides additional columns that indicate whether a CID is used
# in a particular CMap file, and if so, provides the encoded value.
# Here are some common aspects of the data that you will find in this
# table:
#
# o All character codes are provided in hexadecimal notation.
#
# o Many of the CMap files indicated at the head of each column have
#   both "-H" (horizontal writing mode) and "-V" (vertical writing
#   mode) versions. Those with only a "-H" version are explicitly
#   shown with the "-H" appended. Those with both do not have a
#   writing mode suffix.
#
# o The character codes found in a corresponding "-V" (vertical
#   writing mode) CMap file are indicated by a "v" appended to the
#   hexadecimal code.
#
# o There may be cases of single CIDs being referenced in multiple
#   encoding points within a single CMap file. These cases are
#   comma-delimited, within the same column.
#
# The following is a synopsis of columns 2 through 14, and provides
# information about character set and encoding:
#
# o Column 2: Character codes for the "GB-H" and "GB-V" CMaps (GB
#   2312-80 character set, ISO-2022-CN encoding).
#
# o Column 3: Character codes for the "GB-EUC-H" and "GB-EUC-V" CMaps
#   (GB 2312-80 character set, EUC-CN encoding, half-width Latin
#   characters).
#
# o Column 4: Character codes for the "GBpc-EUC-H" and "GBpc-EUC-V"
#   CMaps (MacOS-S character set, EUC-CN encoding, proportional Latin
#   characters).
#
# o Column 5: Character codes for the "GBT-H" and "GBT-V" CMaps (GB/T
#   12345-90 character set, ISO-2022-CN encoding).
#
# o Column 6: Character codes for the "GBT-EUC-H" and "GBT-EUC-V"
#   CMaps (GB/T 12345-90 character set, EUC-CN encoding, half-width
#   Latin characters).
#
# o Column 7: Character codes for the "GBTpc-EUC-H" and "GBTpc-EUC-V"
#   CMaps (GB/T 12345-90 character set for MacOS-S, EUC-CN encoding,
#   proportional Latin characters).
#
# o Column 8: Character codes for the "GBK-EUC-H" and "GBK-EUC-V"
#   CMaps (GBK character set used on Windows 95 for PRC Chinese,
#   GBK encoding, half-width Latin characters).
#
# o Column 9: Character codes for the "GBKp-EUC-H" and "GBKp-EUC-V"
#   CMaps (GBK character set used on Windows 95 for PRC Chinese,
#   GBK encoding, proportional Latin characters).
#
# o Column 10: Character codes for the "GBK2K-H" and "GBK2K-V"
#   CMaps (GB 18030-2022 character set, the mixed one-, two-, and
#   four-byte encoding defined in GB 18030-2022, proportional Latin
#   characters).
#
# o Column 11: Character codes for the "UniGB-UCS2-H" and "UniGB-UCS2-V"
#   CMaps (Unicode UCS-2/UTF-16 encoding, proportional Latin characters).
#   (NOTE: These two CMap files are no longer being maintained. The
#   use of the UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32 CMap files is recommended.)
#
# o Column 12: Character codes for the "UniGB-UTF8-H" and "UniGB-UTF8-V"
#   CMaps (Unicode 14.0 UTF-8 encoding, proportional Latin characters).
#
# o Column 13: Character codes for the "UniGB-UTF16-H" and
#   "UniGB-UTF16-V" CMaps (Unicode 14.0 UTF-16 encoding, proportional
#   Latin characters).
#
# o Column 14: Character codes for the "UniGB-UTF32-H" and
#   "UniGB-UTF32-V" CMaps (Unicode 14.0 UTF-32 encoding, proportional
#   Latin characters).
#
# EOF
